notes: Per-source conservative UTC-day dispatch caps for metered or free-credit providers; Neon owns shared daily usage when available. Inference sessions can require many requests; API limits still win and sessions must honor provider quota errors.

orcarouter.account_limits: 50 requests/day, 10 requests/minute per account; unpublished per-request prompt-size cap on free tier

gemini-free.account_limits: Model/project-specific free requests/tokens per day; free-tier project required, never assume paid project is free

groq-free.account_limits: Selected models: 1000 requests/day and 200000 tokens/day, at organization scope

aion-free.account_limits: Free account: 20000 tokens/day total; paid model prices are covered only by daily free allowance

cohere-eval.account_limits: Evaluation API keys: 1000 calls/month; evaluation-only, not production SLA

typhoon-free.account_limits: Free light-usage API; per-model 200 requests/minute, no published durable daily guarantee
